title: Hunter Radar
description:
Developed through the Riata Startup Experience at Oklahoma State University
LoRa wireless technology for offline and online geolocation
AI integrated tracking for areas without cellular coverage
Business model focused on outdoor safety, group coordination, and remote communication

title: GE Aerospace Turbine Manufacturing Engineering
tagline: Turbine hardware processing and quality improvement
description:
Supported turbine hardware processing and quality improvement for military and commercial propulsion programs
Designed VGT inspection tooling for dimensional verification of tight aerospace tolerances
Led Stage 1 nozzle flow investigation analyzing TBC thickness, EDM cutback, geometry, and flow performance
Supported root-cause analysis and process improvements for flight-critical turbine hardware
